[Unit]
Description=Torii Telegram agent coordinator

[Service]
ExecStart="/fixture/python" "-m" "coordinator" "serve" "--coordinator-model" "claude-opus-5-5"
WorkingDirectory=/fixture/checkout
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
KillMode=process
UMask=0077
Environment="PATH=%h/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
StandardOutput=append:/fixture/home/.local/state/telegram-agent-coordinator/service.stdout.log
StandardError=append:/fixture/home/.local/state/telegram-agent-coordinator/service.stderr.log

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
